question: 统计 2024 年 3 月每周的 GMV，仅统计已支付订单，并给出每周的起止日期
sql: SELECT d.year, d.week_of_year, MIN(f.dt) AS week_start, MAX(f.dt) AS week_end, SUM(f.amount) AS gmv FROM fact_order f JOIN dim_date d ON f.date_key = d.date_key WHERE f.dt >= '2024-03-01' AND f.dt < '2024-04-01' AND f.status = 'PAID' GROUP BY d.year, d.week_of_year ORDER BY MIN(f.dt);

question: 统计 2024 年 3 月工作日与周末各自的订单数
sql: SELECT d.is_workday, COUNT(*) AS order_cnt FROM fact_order f JOIN dim_date d ON f.date_key = d.date_key WHERE f.dt >= '2024-03-01' AND f.dt < '2024-04-01' GROUP BY d.is_workday ORDER BY d.is_workday;

question: 统计 2024 年 3 月最后三天的净支付额，仅统计成功支付
sql: SELECT SUM(f.pay_amount) AS net_pay FROM fact_pay f WHERE f.dt >= '2024-03-29' AND f.dt < '2024-04-01' AND f.pay_status = 'SUCCESS';

question: 统计 2024 年上半年各季度的客单价，仅统计已支付订单
sql: SELECT d.quarter, SUM(f.amount) / COUNT(*) AS avg_order_value FROM fact_order f JOIN dim_date d ON f.date_key = d.date_key WHERE f.dt >= '2024-01-01' AND f.dt < '2024-07-01' AND f.status = 'PAID' GROUP BY d.quarter ORDER BY d.quarter;

question: 统计 2024 年 4 月分区键范围内的订单数
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_cnt FROM fact_order f WHERE f.date_key BETWEEN 20240401 AND 20240430;

question: 统计 2024 年 5 月每日订单量，只扫描当月分区
sql: SELECT f.dt, COUNT(*) AS order_cnt FROM fact_order f WHERE f.dt >= '2024-05-01' AND f.dt < '2024-06-01' GROUP BY f.dt ORDER BY f.dt;

question: 统计 2024 年 3 月下单次数不少于 2 次的复购用户数
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS repeat_users FROM (SELECT f.user_id FROM fact_order f WHERE f.dt >= '2024-03-01' AND f.dt < '2024-04-01' GROUP BY f.user_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2) t;

question: 统计 2024 年 3 月发生过成功支付的去重用户数
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT f.user_id) AS pay_users FROM fact_pay f WHERE f.dt >= '2024-03-01' AND f.dt < '2024-04-01' AND f.pay_status = 'SUCCESS';

question: 统计 2024 年 3 月访问过首页的去重用户数
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT f.user_id) AS home_uv FROM fact_visit f WHERE f.dt >= '2024-03-01' AND f.dt < '2024-04-01' AND f.page = 'home';

question: 统计 2024 年 3 月各城市 VIP5 用户的 GMV，仅统计已支付订单
sql: SELECT u.city, SUM(f.amount) AS gmv FROM fact_order f JOIN dim_user u ON f.user_id = u.user_id WHERE f.dt >= '2024-03-01' AND f.dt < '2024-04-01' AND f.status = 'PAID' AND u.vip_level = 5 GROUP BY u.city ORDER BY gmv DESC;

question: 统计 2024 年 3 月各品类已支付订单的销售件数
sql: SELECT p.category, SUM(f.qty) AS total_qty FROM fact_order f JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_id = p.product_id WHERE f.dt >= '2024-03-01' AND f.dt < '2024-04-01' AND f.status = 'PAID' GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY total_qty DESC;

question: 统计 2024 年 3 月各渠道用户的净支付额，仅统计成功支付
sql: SELECT u.channel, SUM(f.pay_amount) AS net_pay FROM fact_pay f JOIN dim_user u ON f.user_id = u.user_id WHERE f.dt >= '2024-03-01' AND f.dt < '2024-04-01' AND f.pay_status = 'SUCCESS' GROUP BY u.channel ORDER BY net_pay DESC;

question: 统计 2024 年 3 月有下单但当月无成功支付记录的用户数
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT f.user_id) AS users_without_pay FROM fact_order f WHERE f.dt >= '2024-03-01' AND f.dt < '2024-04-01' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fact_pay p WHERE p.user_id = f.user_id AND p.dt >= '2024-03-01' AND p.dt < '2024-04-01' AND p.pay_status = 'SUCCESS');

question: 统计 2024 年 3 月订单金额高于当月平均金额的订单数
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM fact_order f WHERE f.dt >= '2024-03-01' AND f.dt < '2024-04-01' AND f.amount > (SELECT AVG(amount) FROM fact_order WHERE dt >= '2024-03-01' AND dt < '2024-04-01');

question: 给出 2024 年 3 月每日已支付订单的 GMV 及前一日 GMV
sql: SELECT dt, gmv, LAG(gmv, 1) OVER (ORDER BY dt) AS prev_gmv FROM (SELECT f.dt AS dt, SUM(f.amount) AS gmv FROM fact_order f WHERE f.dt >= '2024-03-01' AND f.dt < '2024-04-01' AND f.status = 'PAID' GROUP BY f.dt) t ORDER BY dt;

question: 给出 2024 年 3 月 GMV 最高的 5 天及其排名
sql: SELECT dt, gmv, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY gmv DESC) AS rk FROM (SELECT f.dt AS dt, SUM(f.amount) AS gmv FROM fact_order f WHERE f.dt >= '2024-03-01' AND f.dt < '2024-04-01' AND f.status = 'PAID' GROUP BY f.dt) t ORDER BY gmv DESC LIMIT 5;

question: 计算 2024 年 3 月客单价，仅统计已支付订单
sql: SELECT SUM(f.amount) / COUNT(*) AS avg_order_value FROM fact_order f WHERE f.dt >= '2024-03-01' AND f.dt < '2024-04-01' AND f.status = 'PAID';

question: 计算 2024 年 3 月支付成功笔数占全部支付笔数的比例
sql: SELECT ROUND(1.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN f.pay_status = 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 4) AS success_rate FROM fact_pay f WHERE f.dt >= '2024-03-01' AND f.dt < '2024-04-01';

question: 对比 2024 年 3 月与 4 月的 GMV，仅统计已支付订单
sql: SELECT '2024-03' AS ym, SUM(f.amount) AS gmv FROM fact_order f WHERE f.dt >= '2024-03-01' AND f.dt < '2024-04-01' AND f.status = 'PAID' UNION ALL SELECT '2024-04' AS ym, SUM(f.amount) AS gmv FROM fact_order f WHERE f.dt >= '2024-04-01' AND f.dt < '2024-05-01' AND f.status = 'PAID';

question: 找出 2024 年 3 月 GMV 低于当月日均 GMV 的日期
sql: WITH daily AS (SELECT f.dt AS dt, SUM(f.amount) AS gmv FROM fact_order f WHERE f.dt >= '2024-03-01' AND f.dt < '2024-04-01' AND f.status = 'PAID' GROUP BY f.dt) SELECT dt, gmv FROM daily WHERE gmv < (SELECT AVG(gmv) FROM daily) ORDER BY dt;
